rows.grounds: fused compound naming boon-giving, noose, and hand
fused compound naming mace, arrow, and flag in dual accusative

items.question: Which implements and gestures characterize the deity's form in this iconographic description?
premises: The token varadaṃpāśahastaṃ names boon noose and hand.
The token gadāṃbāṇadhvajau names mace arrow and flag.
The conjunctions ca and tathā link these attributes.
items.inference: The verse enumerates the deity's held implements and gestures.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of the fused compound is not fully resolved.
